subject: Mapping evidence for customer-specific log TTLs and SIG/CAIQ artifacts
messages:
From: Pamela Torres <pamela.torres@medbridge.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal-ops@medbridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence matrix request — tenant-level TTL carveout

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we discussed, MedBridge has two narrow requirements for our pilot tenant in production: (1) a 120-day retention window for conversational logs used for billing and safety analysis, and (2) a 7-year keystore rotation proof for signed artifacts related to medical transcription.

Before we move to an addendum, our security & legal teams need a concise mapping showing exactly which Redwood artifacts satisfy SIG/CAIQ questions and SOC 2 evidence for these deviations. Specifically we need:
- A row-level mapping (artifact -> control) for retention and deletion evidence (e.g., API logs, deletion manifests, keystore rotation records).
- Confirmation whether ephemeral session traces are ever persisted beyond the 120-day window and where (region/zone).
- A sample deletion manifest and the canonical timestamp format you use for proofs of delete.

Can you provide an evidence matrix and the SIG/CAIQ responses that call out these items? If possible, include a sample of the keystore rotation logs (redacted) so our auditors can validate rotation cadence.

Target timing: legal wants the packet by Monday 11/16 to start the contract addendum review. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Pamela Torres
Head of Security Programs
MedBridge AI

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Pamela Torres <pamela.torres@medbridge.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence matrix request — tenant-level TTL carveout

Pamela — thanks for the clear list. I can get a compact evidence matrix over to you by end of day Monday.

Plan: Neha will compile the SIG/CAIQ and SOC 2 artifacts; Marissa will pull the engineering examples (deletion manifests, sample API responses, keystore logs). I will assemble the matrix and add a short executive summary for Legal.

Quick notes on feasibility:
- 120-day tenant retention for conversational logs: supported via tenant-scoped ephemeral buckets + persisted audit snapshots. We can produce deletion manifests for snapshots and token-level counts per tenant.
- Keystore rotation: we maintain rotation records and certificate fingerprints; we can provide redacted rotation logs covering the last 3 rotations.

Neha/Marissa — can you confirm you can deliver the two attachments (Retention_Matrix_v1.xlsx, SIG_RESPONSES_20261113.pdf) and a redacted keystore sample by Monday EOD?

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Pamela Torres <pamela.torres@medbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence matrix request — tenant-level TTL carveout

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 10:03 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Pamela — thanks for the clear list. I can get a compact evidence matrix over to you by end of day Monday.

Hi all,

Confirming we can assemble the SIG/CAIQ responses and the SOC 2 artifacts slice that are relevant to retention and deletion controls. What I'll include: 
- SIG control mappings for data retention (Control family: Storage & Transmission; Data Retention columns)
- CAIQ exported responses with callouts for any customer-scoped exceptions (we'll highlight the 120-day tenant carveout)
- A SOC 2 artifact list (policy links, deletion manifest template, audit log index)

I attached the first drafts: SIG_RESPONSES_20261113.pdf (redacted answers, highlighted rows) and Retention_Matrix_v1.xlsx (artifact -> control mapping). The matrix includes columns: artifact_name, control_id, retention_period, evidence_location, sample_file.

Two security caveats:
1) Keystore rotation logs will be redacted to remove any private key material. We will include fingerprints, timestamps, and rotation rationale.
2) For ephemeral session traces that are kept for short troubleshooting windows, we'll add a clear column indicating retention TTL and whether they are persisted outside ephemeral stores.

I attached the artifacts to this thread. Let me know if Legal wants a slightly expanded manifest format (we can add checksum/hash fields).

--
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Pamela Torres <pamela.torres@medbridge.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence matrix request — tenant-level TTL carveout

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 12:45 PM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> I attached the artifacts to this thread. Let me know if Legal wants a slightly expanded manifest format (we can add checksum/hash fields).

Adding a quick engineering mock/sample for context. The matrix references these sample locations and API endpoints: 
- Deletion manifest sample: s3://redwood-evidence/medbridge/20261113/delete-manifest.json (we will provide the JSON payload)
- Audit log sample (redacted): /evidence/audit/medbridge/keystore-rotations/rotation-2026-07-03.log
- Retention API: POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/tenants/{tenant_id}/retention/export?from=2026-08-01&to=2026-11-01

Attached sample: keystore_rotation_logs_sample.txt (redacted fingerprints + timestamps). The retention matrix also includes a column with the authoritative verification artifact (signed manifest or indexed audit record).

If Legal needs signatures on the manifests (DocuSign), we can create a one-page attestation and route it for signature; that would add ~1 business day to delivery.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Pamela Torres <pamela.torres@medbridge.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence matrix request — tenant-level TTL carveout

Thanks Sean / Neha / Marissa — received the attachments and quick read-through. The matrix is helpful and the redacted rotation sample looks sufficient for initial review. A couple of follow-ups from Legal: 
- Could you add a checksum/hash column in the manifest template (per Neha's note)?
- We also want the canonical timezone/timeformat documented in the manifest (ISO8601 with offset is preferred).
- Please include the HubSpot record id and the proposed contract addendum language snippet (one paragraph) that describes the tenant-scoped retention exception.

If you can add those three items and resend Monday morning (11/16), Legal will begin the addendum review. If signature is required we will let you know.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Pamela Torres
Head of Security Programs
MedBridge AI
